start_here: Say to your AI: "Say lines l01 and l02 in the candidate voice model some-org/candidate-tts, cloned from ref.wav, into ./candidate so I can compare it with my current voice."
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: it takes a model id, a reference recording and lines on its command line and writes one WAV per line into a folder.
instructions: 1. Check the voice in ref.wav is your own or one you have the speaker's consent to clone, and read the model's licence (some allow evaluation only).

2. Say the line in start_here. Your AI reads this tool's row with tools:list {tool: "tool:say-lines-in-a-candidate-voice-model"}, installs mlx-audio, numpy and soundfile if missing (a Mac with Apple silicon), and runs the command in given. Use the same line ids your current voice's recordings use.
3. Read the last line: {"result": {model, sample_rate, lines: [{line, wav, seconds, took}]}} or {"error": "what to change"} (exit 2).
4. Score ./candidate against your current voice's folder with tool:score-how-alike-lines-sound-to-a-reference-voice, and still listen.

worked_examples.title: Two lines said in a cloned voice, one WAV each
worked_examples.ask: Say these two lines in the candidate model in my voice.
worked_examples.given: Read from tools/compare-voice-and-music-models/do-work/say_lines.py (its argument checks are in tools/compare-voice-and-music-models/test/test_compare_models.py; the model run itself is not tested). Run: python3 -I tools/compare-voice-and-music-models/do-work/say_lines.py some-org/candidate-tts ./candidate ref.wav "the words said in ref.wav" l01="First line." l02="Second line." The model loads (first run downloads it), ref.wav is cloned, and each line is generated.
worked_examples.hands_back: {"result":{"model":"some-org/candidate-tts","sample_rate":<the model's rate>,"lines":[{"line":"l01","wav":"./candidate/l01.wav","seconds":<its length>,"took":<seconds it took>},{"line":"l02","wav":"./candidate/l02.wav","seconds":...,"took":...}]}}: ./candidate/l01.wav and ./candidate/l02.wav are 24-bit WAVs at the model's rate. With no lines the last line is {"error":"pass <model id> <out dir> <ref wav> <ref text> and at least one <line id>=<text>"} (exit 2); a line "l01=  " is refused as "is not <line id>=<text>".
